I answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was **Southgate**.

He's a member of that channel, so I only read the channel itself. On 2025-09-03, Priyanka posted there that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. When she closed the incident at 18:43, she said Southgate had cleared the backlog.

I also told him the channel doesn't give a street address for the site.
